hypothesis: On separately sampled selected-action A-B-A causal worlds, a trainable two-context fast-memory selector with directional bank agreement retains the original regime while adapting to changes, beyond matched fully trained nondirectional and fixed nearest-bank controls.
null: No reproducible joint new-regime adaptation and cold old-regime recall gain over strongest eligible matched-state control.

source.law: Independent Gaussian 4x4 terminal selected-action law per world, stable role bias. Half worlds retain A-A-A, half use A-B-A where B is a 90 degree rotation of the 2D selected physical terminal effect subspace for action roles 0,1 only; stable roles 2,3 unchanged. This is not R64 full-vector sign reversal.

train.predeclared_training_target: Uniform selected-action PRE-UPDATE terminal MSE on FIT events, all 48 steps. No evaluator labels or future effects.
train.selection: Fixed deterministic FIT sample indices with replacement, draw seed 23719999+model_seed. All arms see same index order.
train.source_boundary: FIT-only training; CAL diagnostic only; no CAL/DEV threshold tuning or gradient update

architectures.persistent_memory: Two 4x4 factual fast-weight banks plus one scalar bank selector; all arms allocate and use both banks
architectures.write_rule: Pre-action estimate blend of two banks by the last p. After observed y, update p via sigmoid allowed factual features and update both banks with gain 0.55 and mixture weights p/(1-p), each event. No phase or private labels.
architectures.fixed_control: fixed_two_bank_nearest: after selected factual y, p is fixed sigmoid bank0-vs-bank1 terminal fit distance; same 33 floats, same dual-bank write/update budget

metrics.primary: Equal weighted sum of switched-world B changed-role, first A-return, and stable-world overall MSE
metrics.control_selection: For each seed choose lowest frozen DEV joint score among trained nondirectional_surprise, trained random_negative and fixed_two_bank_nearest. Strongest-of-controls is mandatory; no after-result source/model tuning.
